verses.text: Pursue love, and eagerly desire spiritual gifts—especially the gift of prophecy.
The one who speaks in a language no one knows speaks to God, not to people. No one understands them; by the Spirit they speak mysteries.
But the one who prophesies speaks to people to strengthen, encourage, and comfort them.
Speaking in a language no one else understands strengthens the speaker, but prophecy strengthens the church.

I want you all to speak in other languages, but even more, I want you to prophesy. The one who prophesies is greater than the one who speaks in languages, unless someone interprets so the church can be built up.
Brothers and sisters, if I came to you speaking in languages you don't understand, how would that help you unless I also brought a revelation, knowledge, prophecy, or teaching?
Even lifeless instruments like a flute or harp have to make distinct notes. Otherwise, how would anyone recognize the tune?
And if a trumpet gives an unclear signal, who will get ready for battle?
It's the same with you: if you don't speak words people can understand, how will anyone know what you're saying? You'll just be talking into the air.
There may be many languages in the world, and not one of them is meaningless.
But if I don't know what someone's language means, we'll be strangers to each other.
Since you're eager for spiritual gifts, seek to excel in gifts that build up the church.
So the one who speaks in another language should pray for the ability to interpret it.
If I pray in a language I don't understand, my spirit is praying, but my mind isn't producing anything useful.
So what should I do? I'll pray with my spirit, and I'll pray with my mind too. I'll sing with my spirit, and I'll sing with my mind too.
Otherwise, if you give thanks in the spirit, how can someone who doesn't understand say ‘Amen’ to your thanksgiving? They don't know what you're saying.
You may be giving thanks well, but the other person isn't being built up.
I thank God that I speak in other languages more than all of you.
But in church I'd rather say five words that I understand, so I can teach others, than ten thousand words in a language no one understands.
Brothers and sisters, don't think like children. Be innocent about evil, but mature in your thinking.
The law says, ‘I will speak to this people through people who speak unfamiliar languages and through the lips of foreigners, but even then they won't listen to me, says the Lord.’
So languages are a sign for unbelievers, not believers; prophecy is a sign for believers, not unbelievers.
If the whole church gathers and everyone speaks in other languages, and outsiders or unbelievers come in, won't they say you're out of your minds?
But if everyone is prophesying and an unbeliever or outsider comes in, they'll be convicted by all and examined by all.
The secrets of their heart will be exposed. They'll fall facedown and worship God, saying, ‘God is truly among you!’
So, brothers and sisters, what should you do? When you gather, each person may have a song, a teaching, a revelation, a language, or an interpretation. Let everything be done to build people up.
If someone speaks in another language, let two—or at most three—speak, one at a time, and someone must interpret.
If there's no interpreter, the speaker should stay quiet in the church and speak privately to God.
Let two or three prophets speak, and let the others weigh what is said.
If someone sitting down receives a revelation, the first speaker should stop.
You can all prophesy one by one, so everyone can learn and be encouraged.
The spirits of prophets are under the control of the prophets.
God isn't a God of disorder but of peace, as in all the churches of God's people.
Women should be quiet in the churches. They aren't permitted to speak, but should be in submission, as the law also says.
If they want to learn something, they should ask their own husbands at home. It's shameful for a woman to speak in the church.
Did God's word originate with you? Are you the only ones it has reached?
If anyone thinks they're a prophet or spiritual, they should recognize that what I'm writing is the Lord's command.
If anyone doesn't recognize this, they won't be recognized.
So, my brothers and sisters, eagerly desire to prophesy, and don't forbid speaking in other languages.
But let everything be done in a fitting and orderly way.
